descripcion: Mission objectives: kinds of tests NASA runs at Earth analog sites, the campaigns that back each one and the environment traits the sources name as the reason for the site. Format: docs/contrato-misiones.md. The mapping of each trait to this tool's parameters is our own.

misiones.que_se_prueba: Field-testing of life-detection instruments (fluorescence immunoassay, wet chemistry, spectrometers) on real hyperarid soils, rock and salt that are hard on microbial life.
